ADD_WIDEN.note: DECIMAL(15,2) max + 0.01: result type widens to DECIMAL(16,2), so no overflow

SUB_WIDEN.note: DECIMAL(15,2) min - 0.01: result type widens to DECIMAL(16,2), so no overflow

MUL_WIDEN.note: DECIMAL(15,2) * DECIMAL(15,2) widens to DECIMAL(30,4), so no overflow

RESCALE_WIDEN.note: Operand rescale at the DECIMAL(15,2) limit; result type absorbs it

WIDE_ADD_OVERFLOW.note: Operands already at precision 38, so the result type cannot widen

WIDE_SUM_OVERFLOW.note: Global SUM of positive DECIMAL(38,0) values; GPU SUM currently wraps (known gap vs CPU)

WIDE_GROUP_SUM_OVERFLOW.note: Per-grp SUM of wide_add_overflow rows; needs --num-groups > 1 and enough rows_per_case

WIDE_GROUP_SUM_OK.note: Per-grp SUM of tiny wide_add_ok values should not overflow

BATCH_ADD_WIDEN.note: Forces evaluation of many DECIMAL(15,2) widening adds; useful with large --rows-per-case

BATCH_NULL_MIX_COUNT.note: Counts null-masked overflow replicas; 0 when --null-rate is 0

SCALED_DIV_OVERFLOW.note: Dividing DECIMAL(38,6) max by 0.000001 needs far more than 38 digits
